tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the MRR Bench index by name or category. The index holds 4272 tools with pricing on record; the count is read from the index, not written here.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: All pricing tiers for one tool, with the verbatim pricing-page evidence behind each price and the date it was checked.

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: Price changes matched on domain, plan name, billing period and billing mode. Every row carries evidence_level: L1 = a person reopened the vendor's pricing page and checked the old and new price by hand; L2 = both dates' page snapshots contain the price, machine-checked and not yet human-confirmed. R

tools.name: stack_cost
tools.description: Total cost of a set of tools. Each tool reports its cheapest monthly paid plan; where a tool publishes only an annual price, the response carries the annual total as printed and never a monthly equivalent. Monthly and annual totals come back in separate fields.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search SaaS/AI tools by name or category in the MRR Bench index (4,164 tools with verified pricing)." → after: "Search the MRR Bench index by name or category. The index holds 4272 tools with pricing on record; the count is read from the index, not written here."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
